phys-mech-01-c3.text: NASA Glenn Research Center. Newton's Laws of Motion. NASA Glenn Research Center, Beginner's Guide to Aeronautics.
phys-mech-01-c3.quote: Whenever one object exerts a force on a second object, the second object exerts an equal and opposite force on the first.
phys-mech-01-c3.claim: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.

phys-mech-01-c1.text: NASA Glenn Research Center. Newton's Laws of Motion. NASA Glenn Research Center, Beginner's Guide to Aeronautics.
phys-mech-01-c1.quote: If there is no net force acting on the object, then the object will maintain a constant velocity.
phys-mech-01-c1.claim: An object at rest stays at rest, and an object in motion stays in motion at constant velocity, unless acted on by a net external force.
